literal: Towards sulking I went, alas, O friend; having forgotten that, towards union went my heart.
translation: O friend, I went to him intending to sulk, but my heart forgot that and rushed towards union.
modern: தோழியே, நான் அவரிடம் ஊடல் கொள்ளவே சென்றேன்; ஆனால் என் நெஞ்சம் அதை மறந்து அவருடன் கூடி மகிழவே சென்றுவிட்டது.
explanation: The heroine confides in her close friend about her failure to stay angry with her lover. She explains that she approached him fully intending to engage in feigned anger (ūṭal). However, her heart betrayed her conscious intentions. Forgetting the resolve to sulk, her heart eagerly rushed towards joyful union (kūṭal) instead. This contrast highlights the overpowering nature of her affection, which easily defeats her attempts to be upset.
